name: 14b-merge-messages-single-tools
description: The `single: true` + `tools: true` corner, which fixtures 14 and 15 leave out. `single` rewrites every role to `user` at :884 -- including a `tool` turn, so the role test at :895 finally allows the squash to fold it in, and the `tools` flag keeps the tool_call_id that the default path would have deleted. The `tool` turn also carries a `name`, so the generic name prefix at :864-868 fires before `single` runs: the name is turned into a content prefix and then `delete`d at :886. The order of the two blocks is what makes the result stable, and a port that applies `single` first then re-runs the name rules would prefix twice.
